messages:
incident-bot: Pager: smart-routing-policy-alert triggered for route /v1/chat at 03:14 UTC — potential fallback loop detected. Affected customers: 2. Severity: P1
oncall-rai: acked. I'm looking. Can someone grab logs for route evaluation?
sre-amy: grabbing logs from routing service now. seeing repeated policy evaluations where region fallback picks 'quant-variant-v2' even though request includes tool_call=true. looks like model_compat matrix returns 'true' for tool_call support on that variant
ml-raj: wait, quant-variant-v2 is a 4-bit quantized build we onboarded — it does NOT support tool calling (no function/schema hooks). how is compat matrix saying it does?
pm-jordan: support tickets piling up: customers report function calls return structured error or truncated JSON -> we have a support thread from customer AcmeCorp experiencing tool call failures right when traffic hit 03:12-03:16 UTC
support-lee: yes, we're seeing ~120 failed tool-call requests (502 / downstream error) for AcmeCorp, intermittent. Routing shows failover path: us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 -> us-west-2 (loop) for some requests
oncall-rai: noted. initial mitigation: I'll temporarily pause smart-routing policy so explicit region preference is used. doing it now. @ops-bot, can you apply the policy pause?
ops-bot: executed: smart-routing-policy 'fallback-heuristic-v3' paused by oncall-rai at 03:18 UTC. New routing uses static region_map for 2m.
sre-amy: after pause, failures drop to near 0 for AcmeCorp. looks like fallback loop and wrong variant selection were correlated. collecting stack traces and policy decision logs and saving to /var/logs/incidents/1893456789/
ml-raj: digging into the compatibility matrix generator — found a data migration script we ran last week that renamed the 'supports_tool_call' column to 'tooling_supported' but the loader still reads the old column name in fallback codepath; defaulting to true. so quant variants got marked compatible
infra-dana: oh, that explains it. the kernel of the problem: decisions use compatibility table + region fallback to pick variant. if compat table lies, autoswitch picks incompatible model and downstream tool_call fails, then fallback triggers again -> loop.
pm-jordan: customer impact summary for now: AcmeCorp saw a spike in function failures for 4 minutes, causing degraded UX for ~500 end-users. legal/CS notified. Need official RCA and communication.
sre-amy: short-term: pin AcmeCorp's route to fp16-variant-v1 (explicit_model=fp16-variant-v1) and disable fallback to quant variants for routes with tool_call=true. I'll push canary change to routing config.
oncall-rai: doing handoff: @infra-dana you're now primary for remediation and postmortem. I'm OOTO in 35min.
infra-dana: taking it. first step: revert compat table migration and rebuild matrix from last known-good snapshot. ETA ~25m.
ml-raj: I'll prepare a patch to the loader so both column names are supported and add schema validation. also adding unit tests for tool_call compatibility and context-length constraints.
support-lee: writing proactive message to AcmeCorp that we're investigating and have a temporary mitigation in place. cc @customer-success-maya
customer-success-maya: contacting customer now with mitigation note + ETA for full fix. asking if they'd like traffic pinned until patch.
ops-bot: routing config change applied: AcmeCorp route pinned to fp16-variant-v1, fallback to quant variants disabled for routes with tool_call=true.
sre-amy: monitoring now. latency and error rates normalized for pinned route. I'm keeping a 5m cadence for the next 30m.
ml-raj: heads-up for PMs: quant-variant-v2 will be marked 'incompatible' in the UI until we re-run quant certification with tool_call support. We should surface that to Console.
pm-jordan: agreed. also we need a short public postmortem and internal RCA with timeline and mitigations. assign owners?
infra-dana: owners: infra-dana (remediation + rebuild compat matrix), ml-raj (loader patch + tests), sre-amy (monitor + rollback validation), pm-jordan (customer comms + postmortem), support-lee (customer ops). I'll write the ticket.
oncall-rai: leaving detailed notes here for next oncall: - paused smart-routing-policy - pinned AcmeCorp route - compat table revert in progress - loader patch in review - continue 5m checks - escalate if >1% tool_call error rate
sre-amy: note: logs snippet where decision shows bad flag:
```
[decision] route=/v1/chat user=acmecorp model_choice=quant-variant-v2 reason=fallback_policy fallback_chain=[us-west-2,eu-west-1,us-west-2] comp_table_tooling=true
```
ml-raj: and the fix patch (pseudo):
```yaml
# compat-loader.py: tolerate both column names
if 'supports_tool_call' in row:
  tooling = row['supports_tool_call']
else:
  tooling = row.get('tooling_supported', False)
# validate
if tooling and row['quantized']:
  raise ValidationError('quantized variants cannot claim tool_call support')
```
pm-jordan: timeline note: incident opened 03:14 UTC, mitigation applied (policy pause & pin) 03:18 UTC, full routing pin applied 03:20 UTC, compat-table rebuild started 03:23 UTC.
support-lee: customer response: thanks for quick fix, they'd like a follow-up once quant variant is certified for tool-calls. they requested an incident summary.
infra-dana: compat-table rebuild finished at 03:47 UTC. loader patch deployed to canary at 03:55 UTC. running end-to-end test against tool_call flows.
sre-amy: canary looks clean. promoting loader patch to prod now. monitoring for 15m.
ops-bot: deployment: compat-loader v1.2.3 deployed to prod by infra-dana at 03:59 UTC.
ml-raj: running a sweep to flag any other quant variants that mismatch tooling flags. will add an automated check in the CI to prevent this migration class issue.
pm-jordan: thanks team. postmortem owner is pm-jordan. set severity P1 and schedule 1h RCA meeting.
incident-bot: Incident INC-4821 closed as mitigated at 04:12 UTC. Postmortem link: TBD
infra-dana: handoff complete. leaving additional notes in ticket. if anything pops up ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
